organization.fullName: Alliance for Clinical Trials in Oncology

identificationModule.briefTitle: Oxaliplatin, Leucovorin Calcium, and Fluorouracil With or Without Celecoxib in Treating Patients With Stage III Colon Cancer Previously Treated With Surgery
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Trial of 6 Versus 12 Treatments of Adjuvant FOLFOX Plus Celecoxib or Placebo for Patients With Resected Stage III Colon Cancer

armGroups.label: Arm A - FOLFOX and placebo (12 treatments)
armGroups.description: Patients receive FOLFOX every 2 weeks plus placebo every day for 12 treatments (24 weeks). Each 2-week period is called a cycle. FOLFOX includes oxaliplatin, leucovorin and 5-FU.Then, patients receive placebo alone every day for 3 years total.

armGroups.label: Arm B - FOLFOX and celecoxib (12 treatments)
armGroups.description: Patients receive FOLFOX every 2 weeks plus celecoxib every day for 12 treatments (24 weeks). Each 2-week period is called a cycle. FOLFOX includes oxaliplatin, leucovorin and 5-FU.Then, patients receive celecoxib alone every day for 3 years total.

armGroups.label: Arm C - FOLFOX and placebo (6 treatments)
armGroups.description: Patients receive FOLFOX every 2 weeks plus placebo every day for 6 treatments (12 weeks). Each 2-week period is called a cycle. FOLFOX includes oxaliplatin, leucovorin and 5-FU.Then, patients receive placebo alone every day for 3 years total.

armGroups.label: Arm D - FOLFOX and celecoxib (6 treatments)
armGroups.description: Patients receive FOLFOX every 2 weeks plus celecoxib every day for 6 treatments (12 weeks). Each 2-week period is called a cycle. FOLFOX includes oxaliplatin, leucovorin and 5-FU.Then, patients receive celecoxib alone every day for 3 years total.

interventions.name: celecoxib
interventions.description: Patients receive celecoxib 400 mg administered by mouth, once daily.
